title: master · booth · headphones
system_instruction_addendum: MASTER VOL ADDENDUM: Master sets venue volume, booth is the monitor send, headphones is the cue send. Red zone above -6 dBFS clips. Do not move master mid-set.

tutor_speak.text: three volume knobs sit in the master section: master to the room, booth to your monitor, headphones to your cue.
touch the master knob once so you know where it lives, then leave it at noon.
anything above minus six on the meter is the red zone: that is clipping, not loudness.

hints.text: the master section is the small column at the top of the mixer.
the largest of the three knobs is master volume.
tap the master knob once and put it back to noon.
